purpose: Strongly reject an intention or a proposition.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Plain clause + ものか / もんか; Nな + ものか
I will not give up over something like this.
There is no way I will believe it without asking anything.
One failure certainly does not mean everything is over.
formation: Plain clause + ものか / もんか; Nな + ものか
restrictions: Rhetorical question expresses a strong negative, not a real request.
mistake: Can sound confrontational; もんか is more colloquial.
